_note: Undoc parent + 2 citizen kids. Per 7 CFR 273.11(c)(1)(i), eligible HH size = 2 (kids only) for max allotment / SD / FPL / cap. Per 7 CFR 273.11(c)(3)(i)(A) count-all election (CA), parent's $2000 wages count in full. Prior oracle ($591) was authored to match the pre-#434 engine that used full HH size = 3 for max allotment — that was the bug. New oracle reflects the corrected size-2 + count-all math.
